summary: RTB Digital, Inc., a Nevada corporation listed on Nasdaq Capital Market, filed a Form 8-K on September 18, 2026, regarding a ten-year Strategic Platform Agreement executed September 14, 2026, with Paradium.AI, Inc. (formerly The Arena Group Holdings, Inc.). The agreement has an initial ten-year term and is expected to commence in Q4 2026 upon closing conditions, including due diligence, RTB's capital raise, and definitive documents. No price, stake, premium, or board recommendation is stated; the filing is a material definitive agreement, not a special situation.
